maddeler.e:
ننكفئ (form VII)
# نَنْكَفِئُ (nankafiʔu) /nan.ka.fi.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
# نَنْكَفِئَ (nankafiʔa) /nan.ka.fi.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
# نَنْكَفِئْ (nankafiʔ) /nan.ka.fiʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
